entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker pyromancer racing for Team Cloudspire to win the Aetherspark so she can take Nissa home to Zendikar.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Chandra's partner, a gentle woman from Zendikar who does not want Chandra to fix her problem for her.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother, a former renegade leader and Aether Rangers mechanic who gives Spitfire a new racing suit.

entities.name: Sita Varma
entities.description: A diplomat in training secretly racing as the masked Spitfire, who uses an aether canister to survive the falling platform.

entities.name: Mohar Varma
entities.description: Sita's traditionalist father, a former consul who is approached by intruders offering to restore the old order.

entities.name: Lalan
entities.description: A young seamstress who covers for Sita by claiming Sita is an apprentice at her atelier.

entities.name: Caradora
entities.description: Team leader of the Alacrian Quickbeasts, co-captain with Lagorin.

entities.name: Lagorin
entities.description: A bird-like beast and co-captain of the Alacrian Quickbeasts who dislikes injustice.

entities.name: Vin
entities.description: An eyeball announcer who narrates the Grand Prix with an interpreter.

entities.name: Far Fortune
entities.description: A rugged Endriders road warrior who intimidates Spitfire.

entities.name: Kolodin
entities.description: The captain of Team Cloudspire who gives a stirring speech.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A gaunt, exhausted team leader who keeps a fuzzy creature in a tiny cage and drives ghoul-built vehicles.

entities.name: Suraj Chaudry III
entities.description: A mason's son who built a Grand Prix platform and loves racing and the night minister.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: The night minister and grand marshal who fires the signal flare to start the race.

entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: A figure leading a last-minute explosive safety workshop for the goblin racers.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A stirring speaker Chandra compares Kolodin to.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer whose ghouls Chandra compares with Winter's.

entities.name: Aether Rangers
entities.description: Avishkar's hometown racing team.

entities.name: Team Cloudspire
entities.description: The team for which Chandra races under Kolodin.

entities.name: Alacrian Quickbeasts
entities.description: A beast-powered racing team led by Caradora and Lagorin.

entities.name: Endriders
entities.description: Vagabond racers with hooked chains and a shark-man chordatan.

entities.name: Speed Demons
entities.description: A spectral team that wins the first leg of the race.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: The multiplanar race whose first leg starts in Ghirapur and ends through an Omenpath on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city on Avishkar that hosts the race start.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The renamed plane of Kaladesh.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's home plane which Chandra hopes to take her back to.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: The planar route through which the racers exit the first leg to Amonkhet.

events.summary: Chandra wakes to Nissa reading in bed.
events.quote: Nissa. Her Nissa.

events.summary: Nissa reveals Chandra talked in her sleep about bringing her back to Zendikar and seems crestfallen.
events.quote: You were telling someone how much it would mean to you to bring me back to Zendikar.

events.summary: Nissa says she does not want Chandra to fix the problem for her.
events.quote: I don't want you to fix the problem for me.

events.summary: Pia calls them to breakfast and teases Chandra as her turncoat daughter.
events.quote: Don't deprive me of one last breakfast with my turncoat daughter.

events.summary: Pia laments that Chandra will not wear an Aether Ranger uniform.
events.quote: Of course, she won't be wearing an Aether Ranger uniform.

events.summary: Sita arranges a cover story to leave her father's house for the race.
events.quote: If her father is to believe that she's needed elsewhere, he must see that she is needed elsewhere.

events.summary: Caradora and Lagorin are interviewed by Vin on screen.
events.quote: Lagorin is just as much a leader of our team as I am.

events.summary: Lalan arrives and pretends Sita has an internship at her atelier.
events.quote: I just thought I'd swing by to pick up Sita for her internship.

events.summary: Mohar approves the internship and embraces Sita.
events.quote: When you return, we'll stop by your mother's memorial and show her your creations.

events.summary: Spitfire passes Far Fortune and a shark-man chordatan in the pits.
events.quote: Of all the other racers, Fortune is the only one that really intimidates Spitfire.

events.summary: Pia gives Spitfire a new aether-powered racing suit.
events.quote: Beneath it, she finds a new racing suit.

events.summary: Pia explains the suit's aether capsules grant two seconds of enhanced speed.
events.quote: With one of those capsules in your system, you'll be quicker than the gods for about two seconds.

events.summary: Pia admits the suit was sized for someone else, implying Chandra.
events.quote: It's because I'm taller than her, isn't it?

events.summary: Chandra hears a caged creature crying and finds it among Winter's vehicles and ghouls.
events.quote: The cage itself is so small that the creature is forced to stand on its hind legs at all times.

events.summary: Winter warns Chandra off, threatening she will end up last with six pallbearers.
events.quote: Chronic-hero syndrome gets you last place and six pallbearers.

events.summary: Chandra heats and bends the cage bars to give the creature a perch.
events.quote: She pulls two of the bars apart wide enough to make a little perch for the creature.

events.summary: Suraj recalls building the platform and takes his VIP seat.
events.quote: The platform Suraj is standing on is one he oversaw himself.

events.summary: Night Minister Gonti addresses the crowd as grand marshal.
events.quote: We thank all of you for attending.

events.summary: Suraj reveals Gonti approved a cheaper copper alloy for the platforms instead of steel.
events.quote: a cheaper, more quickly made copper alloy instead of steel

events.summary: Gonti fires the signal flare to start the Grand Prix.
events.quote: Gonti fires the flare.

events.summary: The racers surge off the line while Chandra starts in last place.
events.quote: With a speed before now unknown to creation, the racers streak out past the starting gates.

events.summary: The spectator platform begins to topple under the cheering crowd.
events.quote: The platform is going to fall over.

events.summary: An Endrider throws a hooked chain at Spitfire's ride, and she narrowly evades it.
events.quote: The fierce young vagabond throws a hooked chain toward Spitfire's ride.

events.summary: A zombified Amonkheti beast tramples an Endrider's chain and crushes his leg.
events.quote: an Amonkheti beast trample over the chain binding the Endrider to the pole

events.summary: Spitfire uses an aether canister to slow time for herself.
events.quote: Spitfire twists the canister and enters the infinite.

events.summary: Spitfire uses auxiliary thrusters to leap past a spectral arm of the Speed Demons.
events.quote: Flipping a switch on the steering wheel activates the auxiliary thrusters.

events.summary: Spitfire shoots through the gap in the collapsing platform.
events.quote: Spitfire shoots through it.

events.summary: Spitfire emerges through an Omenpath onto Amonkhet to find the Speed Demons took first place and she is second.
events.quote: And Spitfire realizes it's not her.

events.summary: Mohar sees the race footage on every channel and hears a howl in his halls.
events.quote: Every single channel is playing it on loop it seems.

events.summary: A green-skinned woman with tendril hair and a blue-cloaked man paralyze Mohar in his own home.
events.quote: it is a woman he sees—one with green skin and serpentine tendrils for hair.

events.summary: The intruders offer Mohar the power to undo the revolution and restore the old order.
events.quote: Would you like to make that dream a reality?

relations.quote: Are you abandoning your breakfast and your poor old mother?
the beak of Lagorin, her co-captain
We ask them all to keep their acceptances private as long as possible.
You are a Varma, through and through.
Kolodin, the team's captain, stands before a gathered crowd.

relations.note: Scowls at her after she frees space for his caged creature.
relations.quote: Team Leader Winter scowls at her.
